column1: # Hear `audio.md §8.9`'s long descent from a deterministic drowning.
# `drowning-audio` waited for an encounter to sink the frigate and never got
# one: over 27 runs on 2026-10-14 nine encounters fired and every one boarded,
# leaving the party in deck combat, and `drowning-audio-lowhull` then lost the
# Avatar to a serpent on deck instead of drowning. This scenario uses the
# other hull route `overworld.md §6.2.5` publishes: a frigate with sails
# hoisted whose released movement is refused prints `COLLISION!` and runs the
# frigate arm of `§6.2.4`'s absorption, one draw in the closed interval
# The seed differs from `seed-drowning-audio-lowhull` only in where the ship
# is and how the wind blows: the furled frigate sits on the deep-water cell
# west of a coast cell, heading east, with a North wind, so `weather.md §5`
# makes east a crosswind and the movement releases on the first pass. Hull is
# 1 (`formats/saved-gam.md §8.1`, the player record's `+0x05`), so every roll
# destroys it; skiffs and the carpet stock (`0x020A`) are zero, so
# `vehicles.md §6`'s ladder reaches its last rung: `Ship sunk!`, the long
# descent, `DROWNING!!!`. The first `Right` after hoisting only sets the
# cached sail direction (`weather.md §5`: a heading that differs from the
# cache turns and does not move); the second releases into the coast.
# The two sides are driven separately, and the side not being recorded is
# muted with Ctrl-S, because the capture sink mixes both processes: in the
# first run the stock game sank on its own while the engine was being
# recorded - after the hoist and one `Right` the original kept sailing on the
# cached direction without another key (`weather.md §5`'s synthesized
# repeats), where this engine waited for the second `Right`. Ctrl-S
# suppresses output only (`audio.md §3`), so it changes no timing. The stock
# game is only muted once its rescue cinematic (`blackthorn.md §7`) has run
# and been acknowledged, since Ctrl-S is a command-loop key.
# requires-seed: profile `seed-drowning-collision` (frigate, hull 1, no skiffs or carpet, west of a coast, North wind)

column4: Furled frigate west of the coast
DOSBox: hoisted, one eastward key into the coast
Engine: the released eastward movement into the coast
